By virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by the District of Columbia Alley Dwelling Act, approved June 12, 1934 (48 Stat. 930), the Architect of the Capitol is hereby designated as a member of the Alley Dwelling Authority vice the Director of Housing of the Federal Emergency Administration of Public Works.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

January 5, 1938.
